metrics.profile_summary: Results-driven digital marketing leader with over 12 years of experience specializing in performance marketing, SEO, and eCommerce growth. Proven track record of scaling revenue for major consumer brands through high-ROAS paid media and integrated organic strategies.

education.institution: Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science and Technology

experience.description: Leads digital growth via Google/Meta Ads and SEO for a luxury fashion brand, focusing on integrated campaigns and brand equity.
Managed full-funnel digital strategies, achieving high ROAS on Google/Meta and boosting organic traffic by 50% YoY.
Led eCommerce transformation to Shopify, scaled revenue to PKR 4 billion, and managed cross-functional social, PR, and content teams.
Managed digital marketing for 100+ UK clients, leading teams of content writers and SEO specialists.
Launched eCommerce brand, implemented performance marketing with 10-15x ROAS, and managed influencer campaigns.
Planned and managed overall SEO/SEM strategy and social content for multiple network sites.

strengths: Extensive experience with top-tier Pakistani consumer brands
Expert-level proficiency in GA4 and ad platform reporting
Proven track record of scaling eCommerce revenue and ROAS
Strong leadership experience managing cross-functional teams
weaknesses: Educational background is in IT rather than Marketing/Business Administration
evaluation.summary: An over-qualified candidate with 12+ years of experience in the exact domain required. He possesses deep technical expertise in GA4 and paid media, has managed teams, and has a proven history of driving growth for large consumer brands in Karachi.
